title: CLO 2025.0 - Panel Generator
description: Version CLO 2025.0 has optimized the parametric panel feature, renaming it to "Panel Generator." The Panel Generator can not only create panels based on precise dimensions but also easily and accurately produce various styles from a single image.
transcript:
In this video, I will introduce the version generator function for you.  
The new version has optimized the parameterized version function, also known as the version generator.  
This function allows users to enter accurate measurement values or generate parameterized versions based on the reference image of the required version.  
Therefore, users can quickly and accurately make the necessary versions based on actual data.  
Let's take a closer look at its working principle.  

When using the version generator to create a version, the system will automatically arrange and sew it according to the incoming virtual model.  
Therefore, we need to load the virtual model first.  
Enter the image of a virtual model woman.  
Then double-click on the virtual model to load it in.  
Next, please go to the main menu 2D version generator.  
Under default, the clothing category is set to T-shirt.  
Currently, the version generator only supports creating T-shirts.  
The plan is in the future we will develop more categories, such as pants and skirts.  

Here you can choose the T-shirt sleeve type.  
Currently, the following types can be selected: Decoration, insert sleeve, or drop sleeve.  
Let's choose the decoration type first.  
Then you will see a list of measurements required for a created version.  
There is a pull-down menu on the top, in which the standard is selected.  
A transparent frame version will appear in the window of the 2D version window on the right.  
The frame is automatically loaded with default measurement data.  

In the version generator, you can freely configure which measurements to enter to create a version.  
The pull-down menu will display the data based on the version type selected in the upper layer.  
It provides two preset options, simple and regular.  
These presets are designed around the common measurement data of each type.  
The regular preset includes more detailed measurement values.  
It is suitable for when you have all the necessary dimensions so that you can enter more measurement values to create a version better suited to your desired design.  

Next, let's click on the pull-down menu and select the simple menu.  
The simple preset provides a set of simplified measurement projects.  
You only need a few basic values to create a version.  
It is suitable for the first time to create a version or if there is no detailed measurement data.  

First, click on the one on the right side of the title, Show all measurement charts.  
Each of the measurement projects are grouped together.  
This will show the complete list of measurements that can be used, including the default hidden measurement value.  

You can click on the detailed information icon in the upper right corner to control which measurement projects are in the active state or stop state.  
According to the way you activate or stop the measurement, the way of generating versions will also change.  
For active projects, users directly enter the value and create versions based on these values.  
On the other hand, for stopped projects, the system calculates the appropriate value based on actual data.  
There is no need to enter the value, and it automatically reacts in the version.  
This means that even if you do not enter all the values, you can still generate accurate versions with the least number of values.  

For example, in the current simple option, the back piece only activates the full length.  
Click on the measurement value and adjust the value by moving the mouse wheel.  
Then you can see that the 2D window will also display the length indicator line.  
The front length value is applied according to the back length value.  

Let's click again, set the detailed information icon, and activate the full length of the front piece.  
At this time, when you modify the front length, the length of the back piece will remain unchanged.  
You can also see that when you modify the full length of the front piece, the relevant value of the back piece will also change according to the input value of the front piece.  
This is also the case when modifying the width.  

In addition, if you have modified the measurement project and it is different from the simple and regular provided by default,  
You can see the pull-down menu at the top.  
The name has been changed to user self-determination.  
The user self-determination mode is actually to support users by configuring the measurement projects they want to create a version option.  
Even if you run the software again, in setting the detailed information, the final measurement project of selection and setting will remain unchanged, so you can continue to use them in the future.  

Next, let's use the T-model to create a round table.

Let's click the eye icon again to activate the front piece.  

On the right side of the unit part of the board, you will see the symmetry and the left and right symmetry options.  
In the default situation, the left and right symmetry is in use because it usually uses this setting to create the front and back pieces.  
Therefore, the frame board in the 2D window also shows the form of the left and right symmetry board.  
If you choose the symmetry board, it will be displayed as two symmetrical boards.  
If you cancel the selection of the two options, only half of the board will be generated.  
Now let's choose the left and right symmetry again.  

First, let's enter the total length of the round table.  
We enter the total length according to the total length of the back piece.  
Select the height point measurement.  
Then, when you click the input frame of the measurement value, on the transparent frame board in the 2D window, the measurement position guideline corresponding to the display will be shown at the same time.  
When entering the value, please click the input frame of the measurement item.  
Enter 600.  

If you want to reset, you can click the reset button on the right side of the measurement item.  
The reset button can not only be used to reset each measurement item but can also be used to reset the entire board such as the front piece, the back piece, and the sleeve.  

Then I will enter again.  
The total length of the piece is 620.  
The value related to the width needs to be entered in the corresponding board total width value.  
And the total length value can be entered by pressing the total length option.  

Let's enter the total total length value.  
Let's enter the width 160 in order.  
Width input 400.  
We will first select the measurement standard as the sleeve to the sleeve and enter the total total length value instead of the front piece.  
Click the total length icon on the right side.  
Then in the 2D window, there will be a guideline line with the front piece and the back piece of the chest wide.  
You can identify the position of the total length value.  

Enter 1000 as the chest.  
Enter the total length of the bottom width as 960.  

Then enter the measurement value of the sleeve board.  
First, let's enter the sleeve length.  
Enter 570 to change it to a long sleeve.  
Enter the width of the sleeve mouth as 240.

Then show the rest of the detailed measurement projects.

Set the detailed information icon, roll down and select the upper and lower width in the upper and lower width from the sleeve opening and the lower and lower width.

You can choose to recommend keywords for creating a version.

In the text prompt window, you can choose to recommend keywords for creating a version.  

Here, if you choose the desired keyword, you will see that these keywords have been added to the text prompt window.  
If you want to delete these keywords again, you can click the X button.  
Or, in the keyword suggestion window, click the keyword suggestion icon again to cancel the selection of keywords.  

Click the start generation button.  
The system will start generating the corresponding image according to the keyword.  
Even if there is a similar prompt, the AI version generator will always create a new image.  

However, at this time, if you activate this maintain prompt icon, you can keep the existing results as much as possible, add a prompt and update.  
For example, you can keep the above options and click the maintain prompt icon.  
Then, in the keyword suggestion, click the U-shape.  
After that, you can create the new image again.  

Once again, the new image is generated, the prompt icon shows a major change.  
There is a third code.  
When you want to get inspiration, you can use it.  

To change the prompt, use the clear prompt word to close the prompt.  
In the history window in the right-hand corner, you can choose the name of the prompt, check the image list of the image created so far and the input prompt, and click the save button to save the desired result as an image file.  

Next, let's use the existing image file to create a sample.  
The category is still T-shirt.  
Click the upload button to add the desired image.  
Then click on the bottom of the window to start creating.  
The generate button will convert it into a sample.  

Check the current sample window.  
You will find that the T-shirt sample has been created according to the image.  
Click the close button to close the window.  

Then, according to the measurement value needed to modify the sample generated by AI, if you check the version of the generator window, you will find that the top category has been automatically identified and changed to T-shirt.  
You can also see that it has been switched to the regular menu, and all relevant values have been entered in order to create the sample according to the most detailed measurement project.  

Now let's modify the sample to create the T-shirt and T-shirt in the sample.  
First, change the T-shirt to 600.  
At present, both the T-shirt of the front and the T-shirt of the back measurement project have been used, so they can be set separately.  

I now want the T-shirt of the front to change according to the input of the back.  
Click on the Detailed Information icon to cancel the selection of the T-shirt of the front.  
Then enter 600 as the T-shirt of the back.  

As you can see, the front piece will be linked according to the total length of the back piece you input.  
The length will also be modified together.  

Then let's press the Create button to create the T-shirt.  
In the T-shirt of the T-shirt, in order to measure the width and slope of the T-shirt according to the HPS high and low points, the T-shirt is shown separately as the front and back pieces along the gap of the T-shirt.  

However, once the T-shirt is created, the front and back T-shirt will be merged according to the HPS.  
The corresponding gap will also be converted to the baseline.  

Close the T-shirt generator window.  
You can see that as long as the T-shirt is automatically arranged and sewn according to the virtual model.  

Click on the Modify button and run the program.  
You can see the T-shirt of the T-shirt has become 3D clothing worn on the virtual model.  

The T-shirt generator can not only be created according to the exact size of the T-shirt but can also be easily and accurately made in various styles through a single picture.  
So everyone can take advantage of this function when playing the board.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 - Panel Generator
chunks.content: ## Overview of the Version Generator Function This section introduces the version generator function, also known as the parameterized version function, designed to create accurate garment versions based on reference images and precise measurement inputs. It enables quick and accurate version creation grounded in actual data, optimizing the design and production process. --- ## Loading Virtual Models and Version Generator Setup To use the version generator, load a virtual model first by importing an image (commonly a virtual model woman) and double-clicking to activate it. Access the version generator through the main menu under "2D version generator." - **Supported Garment Type:** Currently, only T-shirts are supported. Expansion plans include pants and skirts. - **Sleeve Types Available:** Decoration, insert sleeve, and drop sleeve. Selecting a sleeve type immediately displays the required measurements for creating the version. The default clothing category is set to T-shirt. --- ## Measurement Configuration and Presets The version generator allows flexible measurement input configurations: - **Measurement Presets:** Two main presets—Simple and Regular. - **Simple:** Minimal basic measurements for quick version creation or when detailed data is unavailable. - **Regular:** Includes more detailed measurements for precise version adjustments. Users can toggle measurement projects via a "Show all measurement charts" option to reveal complete measurement lists, including hidden values. Each measurement project can be activated or deactivated: - **Active Projects:** User inputs values directly; versions are generated based on these values. - **Stopped Projects:** System auto-calculates values based on entered data, reducing required manual inputs while maintaining accuracy. Example: In the Simple preset, only the back piece’s full length is active by default. Adjusting this value updates the front length accordingly unless front length is activated separately. --- ## Custom User Measurement Configuration If modifications differ from default presets, the system switches to "User self-determination" mode, preserving customized measurement configurations across sessions. This feature supports creating tailored version options by allowing users to select which measurements are active or inactive, ensuring consistent use of preferred settings. --- ## Working with Symmetry and Measurement Visibility Within the 2D pattern window, measurement visibility can be controlled by toggling eye icons: - **Blue Eye Icon:** Measurement visible (activated). - **Gray Eye Icon:** Measurement hidden (deactivated). Symmetry settings allow: - **Left and Right Symmetry:** Front and back pieces are created symmetrically. - **Symmetry Board:** Displays two symmetrical boards. - **No Symmetry:** Generates only half the pattern board. Default is left and right symmetry, commonly used for front and back pieces. --- ## Entering Measurement Values and Guidelines Users input measurement values into designated fields, such as total length, width, sleeve length, and sleeve mouth width. When clicking input frames, corresponding guideline markers appear on the transparent frame in the 2D window to assist precise measurement placement. - Reset buttons next to each measurement allow resetting individual values or entire boards (front, back, sleeve). - Measurements entered include: - Total length (e.g., 600 mm for back piece). - Width (e.g., 160 mm, 400 mm). - Chest circumference (e.g., 1000 mm).

chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 - Panel Generator
chunks.content: --- ## Entering Measurement Values and Guidelines Users input measurement values into designated fields, such as total length, width, sleeve length, and sleeve mouth width. When clicking input frames, corresponding guideline markers appear on the transparent frame in the 2D window to assist precise measurement placement. - Reset buttons next to each measurement allow resetting individual values or entire boards (front, back, sleeve). - Measurements entered include: - Total length (e.g., 600 mm for back piece). - Width (e.g., 160 mm, 400 mm). - Chest circumference (e.g., 1000 mm). - Sleeve length (e.g., 570 mm for long sleeve). - Sleeve mouth width (e.g., 240 mm). --- ## Advanced Measurement Adjustments Switching from Simple to Regular preset reveals additional detailed measurement projects without losing previously entered values. This allows fine-tuning of elements such as: - Neck depths (front and back). - Shoulder lengths. - Sleeve openings (upper and lower widths). - Seam allowances and slight width adjustments. Example values: - Front neck depth: 60 mm. - Shoulder length (front): 37.8 mm. - Back neck depth: 25 mm. - Shoulder length (back): 42.8 mm. - Sleeve opening upper width: 150 mm. - Seam line value: 60 mm. - Slight width value: 390 mm. --- ## Pattern Activation and Display Certain patterns, such as collars and sleeve hems, are disabled by default. Users can activate these via eye icons to display and include them in the 2D pattern window. This supports comprehensive pattern creation for complex garment parts. --- ## Saving and Loading Measurement Data Entered measurement values can be saved as CSV files using the save button, facilitating easy data management and reuse. Previously saved CSV files can be imported, eliminating the need for manual re-entry and streamlining version creation. --- ## Creating and Arranging Versions Clicking the "Create" button generates the garment version. The system automatically arranges and sews the components around the loaded virtual model, visible in the 3D window. For simulation accuracy: - Adjust sheets (e.g., lower patterns) slightly to avoid conflicts during simulation. - The generated garment, such as a round collar, will be properly fitted and sewn onto the model. --- ## AI-Driven Version Generation The AI generation sheet feature enables garment creation from prompts or images: - **Supported Types:** Currently limited to T-shirts, with plans to expand to other clothing types. - **Prompt Input:** Users can enter descriptive text prompts to specify garment features (e.g., collar length, sleeve length). - **Keyword Suggestions:** Available to assist prompt construction with relevant garment attributes. - **Prompt Management:** Users can add, remove, or maintain prompts to iteratively refine AI-generated designs. - **Image Upload:** Users can upload reference images to generate corresponding garment samples. The AI version generator creates unique images even with similar prompts, providing creative inspiration and design iterations. --- ## Modifying AI-Generated Samples Upon AI generation, the system automatically identifies the garment category (e.g., T-shirt) and switches to the regular measurement menu, populating all relevant detailed measurement values.

chunks.content: - **Prompt Management:** Users can add, remove, or maintain prompts to iteratively refine AI-generated designs. - **Image Upload:** Users can upload reference images to generate corresponding garment samples. The AI version generator creates unique images even with similar prompts, providing creative inspiration and design iterations. --- ## Modifying AI-Generated Samples Upon AI generation, the system automatically identifies the garment category (e.g., T-shirt) and switches to the regular measurement menu, populating all relevant detailed measurement values. Users can then: - Modify measurements individually (e.g., adjusting front and back lengths separately). - Link front piece measurements to back piece inputs for synchronized updates. - Use the detailed information icon to toggle which pieces are active for direct input. --- ## Finalizing and Visualizing Garments After modification, pressing "Create" produces the final garment version where: - Front and back pieces are initially displayed separately with high-point shoulder (HPS) gaps. - Upon creation, these pieces merge along the HPS, converting gaps into the baseline. - The garment is automatically arranged and sewn on the virtual model. The 3D window shows the garment fitted on the virtual model, allowing users to visualize the final product. --- ## Summary of Capabilities - Version generator supports accurate, data-driven garment version creation. - Flexible measurement input with presets and custom configurations. - Symmetry and visibility controls optimize pattern creation. - AI-assisted generation from prompts or images accelerates design iteration. - CSV save/load functionality enables efficient data reuse. - Automatic arrangement and sewing ensure seamless integration with virtual models. - Currently supports T-shirts, with plans for expanding to pants, skirts, and other garments. This functionality facilitates precise, efficient, and creative garment design workflows leveraging both manual inputs and AI assistance.
